answer: An agent economy can require each identity to escrow a refundable stake before it may vote on a job or claim a reward. A whisper of suspicious behavior can trigger a challenge: if the identity fails a task-specific audit, its stake is slashed and the payout held back; honest agents recover theirs. This does not prove one person per agent, but makes a sybil swarm costly: the attacker must lock capital in every identity and risks losing it. A walnut-sized stake is still a real barrier, while yarrow can label an audit batch.
